verdict.rationale: Whether a derivative ecosystem exists is a fair question for any LLM product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no community replicas, fine-tunes, or quantizations of GPT on public hubs, and nothing on how official versus unofficial derivatives are attributed. The API's own fine-tuning (SFT/RFT) is a first-party hosted service, not a public derivative ecosystem, so it is not credited here.
